description: Pin a token image plus metadata and get back the tokenUri for prepare_launch. Provide the image as a public https URL (up to 5 MB), base64 (up to about 700 KB, as requests are capped at 1 MB), or an imageCid from a previous upload (reuse it when only the metadata changes). Optional website/twitter/telegram/discord links surface on the market APIs. Rate limited per IP.

description.description: What the token is about, 1 to 1000 characters

imageBase64.description: The token image as base64, up to about 700 KB

imageCid.description: The IPFS CID (or ipfs:// URI) of an image from an earlier upload, to reuse it

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the token image, up to 5 MB; or use imageBase64 or imageCid

twitter.description: URL of the token's X account

name: upload_token_metadata
